propositions: Add plan-review criterion T15 to require proving risky runtime-only mechanisms via fast out-of-loop experiments before committing them to slow delivery pipelines
T15 applies when a mechanism is delivered through automated pipelines, those passes are slow/costly, and correctness only resolves at runtime (boot, auth, connect, readiness)

Plans satisfying T15 must name specific runtime risks, commit to fast proof experiments (local/emulated or real-target manual probes), run experiments before codifying the mechanism, and clean up only transient artifacts created by the experiment
T10's rubric must be partitioned to exclude transient de-risk experiments from its durable-infrastructure scope, preventing criterion overlap
Registry and documentation must surface T15 via `rebar explain T15`, regenerated criteria-guide, and writing-a-passing-plan guidance
